basic_info.description: Discover breathtaking city views from this modern one-bedroom, one-bathroom condo at The Arterra, Mission Bay’s first LEED Certified building. Featuring an open floor plan, the spacious living room boasts tall ceilings, hardwood floors, and wall-to-wall windows, while the chef’s kitchen includes a large peninsula and updated appliances. The large bedroom features double closets and a beautifully tiled bathroom. In-unit laundry. The Arterra offers luxury amenities, including a 24-hour doorman, fitness center, clubroom, roof deck with BBQ, and a guest suite. Ideally located near CalTrain, Safeway, Oracle Park, Chase Center, and top dining spots, with easy access to Muni and major highways. With a 98 Walk Score, you’re in the heart of San Francisco!
